newsitem.title: USA: Apple's Claris unit Q3 revs down 3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Apple's Claris unit Q3 revs down 3 pct.

text.p: Claris Corp, a wholly owned software subsidiary of Apple Computer Inc, said that it had revenue of $53.9 million for its third fiscal quarter which ended June 27.

Quarterly revenue was down three percent from revenue of $55.6 million in the same quarter last year, and down 23 percent from record revenue of $69.7 million in the quarter ending March 28, Claris said.

Claris said its operating profit in the quarter was higher than operating profit in the same quarter last year, although the company's policy is to not disclose specific quarterly operating profit figures.

Sales of Claris software for Windows PCs made up 36 percent of Claris-brand revenue in the quarter, and the revenue from Windows sales more than doubled over the same quarter last year, the company said.
